visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and a white sleeveless lace top holds a black e-ink tablet towards the camera. She has an exaggerated, surprised facial expression with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. The setting is a cozy indoor living room with a grey sofa and a large green potted plant in the background. Bright, warm indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up top-down view of the device, the iFLYTEK AINOTE Air2, resting on a wooden table. Hands holding a black stylus interact with the screen, navigating through a library of e-books and documents. The E Ink display shows sharp black and white text and covers. (3) The woman is seen again, smiling as she holds the device in her lap while sitting on the sofa. She points at the screen with the stylus, highlighting its thin profile and light weight. The background remains the soft-focus living room setting. (4) Detailed interface close-ups show the stylus writing handwritten notes like '重點' and circling sections of text. The screen then displays a 'ChatGPT' prompt processing the handwriting into summarized digital text. (5) A smartphone appears next to the tablet, demonstrating the AINOTE mobile app. The UI shows synchronization progress bars and cloud backup icons. (6) The woman leans back on the sofa, looking relaxed while reading on the tablet. She looks directly into the lens and waves, concluding the presentation in the same well-lit living room environment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你以為這是一般的電子書嗎？ [Logo]: @aottergirls. (2) [Variety]: 錯了. [Slogan]: 這可是內建 ChatGPT 的智慧筆記本. (3) [Slogan]: 這台 iFLYTEK AINOTE Air2. 有 8.2 吋的類紙 E INK 螢幕. (4) [Slogan]: 重量只有 230g. 超級輕. (5) [Slogan]: 冷暖雙色前光燈. 晚上也能清楚書寫. (6) [Slogan]: 語音功能超給力. 支援 10 種語言即時翻譯！ (7) [Slogan]: 語音轉文字支援 15 種語言. 錄音最長達 280 分鐘. (8) [Slogan]: 點選文字還可以重複聽那段錄音內容. (9) [Slogan]: 點擊手寫筆記播放錄音也會自動切到對應的位置. (10) [Variety]: 同學注意這邊. 這一頁明天會考. (11) [Slogan]: 超順低延遲. 就像在寫紙本一樣. (12) [Slogan]: 迅速轉成文字！ 能轉成 83 種語言. (13) [Slogan]: 還有內建的 ChatGPT 可以幫你自動整理重點. (14) [Slogan]: 使用靈動筆劃圈新增代辦. 畫星星是加關注. (15) [Slogan]: 透過 AINOTE mobile App 連接手機. 筆記同步還能雲端備份！ (16) [Slogan]: 充飽電可以用 7 天. 錄音或文字轉換最長可達 11 小時. (17) [Slogan]: 比平板更護眼！ 比筆電更輕薄！ (18) [Slogan]: 錄音 翻譯 筆記 閱讀 會議 通通搞定！ 學生、上班族都超適合擁有它！

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy female voice speaks with a sharp, rising intonation pattern to grab attention. A rhythmic, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a strong kick-drum beat begins immediately. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes the movement of the tablet. (2) As the narration shifts to detailing specs, the speech rate remains fast and enthusiastic. Frequent high-frequency 'pop' and 'click' sound effects occur, synchronized with visual UI taps. The BGM maintains a consistent four-on-the-floor house rhythm. (3) A brief digital 'ding' sound triggers a new phase as a male voice mimics a classroom teacher with a slightly lower, authoritative pitch. This is followed by a humorous 'bubble' SFX. (4) The female narrator resumes with a slightly higher arousal level as she explains the ChatGPT integration. A shimmering synthesizer effect plays when the text converts on-screen. (5) The final phase features a bright 'stinger' chord as the narration concludes, followed by a quick fade-out of the BGM and a clean studio silence ending.
